_comment: Global commodities tracked in USD directly — no FX conversion needed since these futures/crypto quotes are already dollar-denominated. Sourced via the CME/CBOT/ICE family (not CBOE, which doesn't list agricultural or metals futures — see chat note) through the same yfinance pipeline used for stocks. Grain futures (soybeans/corn/wheat) are historically quoted in US cents per bushel on some feeds — spot-check the first real run to confirm yfinance is returning them in a sane unit before trusting the numbers at face value.
